map.耐力（AT/VO2max）测试是做什么的？: What does Endurance Test Evaluator (AT / VO2max) do?
map.如何使用耐力（AT/VO2max）测试？: How do I use Endurance Test Evaluator (AT / VO2max)?
map.耐力（AT/VO2max）测试适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Endurance Test Evaluator (AT / VO2max) best for?
map.耐力测试综合评估工具，结合无氧阈(AT)和最大摄氧量(VO2max)评估有氧耐力: An endurance-test evaluator combining anaerobic threshold (AT) and VO2max to assess aerobic-endurance level, with training-zone advice and an endurance grade.
map.Cooper：VO₂max = (距离m − 504.9) / 44.73；AT: Cooper: VO₂max = (distance m − 504.9) / 44.73; AT ≈ 85–90% of VO₂max intensity
map.耐力测试综合无氧阈(AT)与最大摄氧量(VO2max)：12 分钟跑距离换算 V: The endurance test combines anaerobic threshold (AT) and maximal oxygen uptake (VO2max): the 12-minute run distance converts to VO2max, and the heart-rate deflection point during graded incremental loading approximates AT; training zones and endurance grades are derived from these.
map.VO2max和无氧阈(AT)是评估耐力的两大核心指标: VO2max and anaerobic threshold (AT) are the two core indicators for assessing endurance
map.VO2max反映最大有氧能力，AT反映可持续运动强度: VO2max reflects maximum aerobic capacity while AT reflects sustainable exercise intensity
map.耐力训练的最佳强度在无氧阈以下5-10bpm: The optimal endurance-training intensity is 5-10 bpm below the anaerobic threshold
map.AT/最大心率比值的80-90%为阈值训练区间: 80-90% of the AT / maximum-heart-rate ratio defines the threshold training zone
map.渐增负荷测无氧阈与最大摄氧。: Measure anaerobic threshold and maximal oxygen uptake with graded incremental loading.
map.耐力选材用渐增负荷测 VO2max 与 AT，区分有氧基础与耐受上限。: For endurance talent selection, graded incremental loading measures VO2max and AT to separate aerobic base from tolerance ceiling.
map.跑台递增速率，达血乳酸 4 mmol/L 即 AT 强度；峰值估 VO2max。: Increase treadmill speed gradually; a blood lactate of 4 mmol/L marks AT intensity, and the peak estimates VO2max.
map.多久测一次？: How often should it be tested?
map.周期中测 1–2 次跟踪进展即可。: Testing once or twice per cycle is enough to track progress.
map.AT 和 VO2max 哪个更该练？: Which should I train more, AT or VO2max?
map.大众健康重 AT（可长期维持强度），竞技重 VO2max 上限，目标不同。: For general health the emphasis is on AT (an intensity sustainable long term) while competitive sport emphasizes the VO2max ceiling; the goals differ.
map.耐力测试综合评估工具结合VO2max和无氧阈(AT)评估有氧耐力水平，按年龄性别: An endurance-test evaluator that combines VO2max and anaerobic threshold (AT) to assess aerobic-endurance level, grades endurance against age- and sex-based reference standards, and provides five training-zone recommendations.
